scriptData.label: Roll to remove Stunned
@effect.name

description.label: Description
description.value:
The tip of your merciless enemy’s weapon drives into the biceps muscle near your elbow, ramming deep and then tearing a path up along the bone almost all the way to your shoulder. It opens up a long, deep and hideous gash along the length of your upper arm. Horrid!

Effects: You gain @Condition[Stunned] (2) and @Condition[Bleeding] (2). Your arm is useless for the rest of the encounter and you also suffer a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.qn4ZpvTQIX4rcJDl]{Torn Muscle (Major)} except only partial healing is possible without Surgery.
